description: C-CAP Regional Land Cover is a nationally consistent time series of 30 m land cover rasters for the coastal United States, mapping up to 25 standard classes including palustrine and estuarine wetlands and developed land. The NOAA Office for Coastal Management produces it through the Coastal Change Analysis Program from satellite imagery and distributes it on the Digital Coast; it is an FGDC National Geospatial Data Asset. Dates available run from 1975 to 2021, updated every five years, with change products, a Land Cover Atlas viewer and worksheets for change analysis, and a separate 1 m high-resolution product for the coast. Coverage is the US coastal zone within the C-CAP mapping boundary. Format and access: bulk raster downloads, custom downloads and map services. Licence: US federal data with no restriction stated, under a NOAA disclaimer and a requested citation; free. Caveats: NOAA says the data are not jurisdictional, suit screening, not site decisions, and small features should be checked against finer data. Wetland loss and impervious growth over time support flood exposure and adaptation studies. Related catalogue records are the US National Wetlands Inventory and the USDA Forest Service tree canopy cover.
